pairs: etsi præoccupatus fuerit homo in aliquo delicto,
if a man has been overtaken by any offense,
vos, qui spirituales estis, hujusmodi instruite in spiritu lenitatis,
you who are spiritual should instruct someone like this with a spirit of leniency,
considerans teipsum, ne et tu tenteris.
considering that you yourselves might also be tempted.
and so shall you fulfill the law of Christ.
Nam si quis existimat se aliquid esse,
For if anyone considers himself to be something,
So let each one prove his own work.
et sic in semetipso tantum gloriam habebit,
And in this way, he shall have glory in himself only,
For each one shall carry his own burden.
Communicet autem is qui catechizatur verbo, ei qui se catechizat,
And let him who is being taught the Word discuss it with him who is teaching it to him,
Do not choose to wander astray.
God is not to be ridiculed.
For whatever a man will have sown,
Quoniam qui seminat in carne sua,
For whoever sows in his flesh,
from the flesh he shall also reap corruption.
But whoever sows in the Spirit,
from the Spirit he shall reap eternal life.
And so, let us not be deficient in doing good.
tempore enim suo metemus non deficientes.
For in due time, we shall reap without fail.
we should do good works toward everyone,
and most of all toward those who are of the household of the faith.
Videte qualibus litteris scripsi vobis mea manu.
Consider what kind of letters I have written to you with my own hand.
Quicumque enim volunt placere in carne,
For as many of you as they desire to please in the flesh,
tantum ut crucis Christi persecutionem non patiantur.
but only so that they might not suffer the persecution of the cross of Christ.
And yet, neither do they themselves, who are circumcised,
they want you to be circumcised,
so that they may glory in your flesh.
But far be it from me to glory,
nisi in cruce Domini nostri Jesu Christi:
except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ,
per quem mihi mundus crucifixus est,
through whom the world is crucified to me,
In Christo enim Jesu neque circumcisio aliquid valet,
neither circumcision nor uncircumcision prevails in any way,
but instead there is a new creature.
Et quicumque hanc regulam secuti fuerint,
and upon the Israel of God.
ego enim stigmata Domini Jesu in corpore meo porto.
For I carry the stigmata of the Lord Jesus in my body.
Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi cum spiritu vestro,
May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit,
